title: local-harvest: quarantine intake, per-file license scan, manifests, notices and Apache-2.0 section 4 audit
goal: CEO Mandate 74 section 5 harvest tooling as a native, repo-agnostic Rust xtask bin. intake pins an upstream commit at refs/susi/upstream/<slug>/<sha> (local, create-only) and records the source URL in <git-common-dir>/susi-harvest; scan verifies each file's license at the pinned commit from git objects only (SPDX header, else nearest license file classified by text; allowlist Apache-2.0, Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception, MIT, BSD-2/3-Clause; copyleft/source-available phrases rejected); import writes approved blobs, .agents/harvest/<id>.json (susi-harvest-manifest-v1), LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and prints Harvest/Origin/Origin-License trailers; notices regenerates or checks THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES deterministically; audit checks schema, allowed licenses, destination presence, 4(a) license text, 4(b) Modified-by notices, 4(c) copyright retention, 4(d) notices freshness and Harvest trailers in a commit range. Upstream content is never checked out, built or executed.

validation.clippy: cargo clippy --offline --locked -p xtask --bin local-harvest --tests -- -D warnings: passed
validation.smoke: built local-harvest.exe links on Windows; `audit` and `notices --check --json` pass on this repository with zero manifests
validation.fixture_scope: Unit tests drive run() against throwaway upstream/work Git repos in the temp dir with isolated Git config: intake by ref and by SHA, scan accept/reject (Apache via LICENSE, MIT via SPDX header, GPL directory rejected), import outputs and refusals, notices determinism and staleness, audit 4(a)/(b)/(c) with the quarantine ref and upstream objects pruned, and Harvest trailer range checks. No real third-party code has been harvested yet.
validation.not_done: audit is not yet wired into release qualification; license detection is heuristic and not legal review (docs/harvest.md).
